using UnityEditor;
using System.Linq;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        // Let's find Trump model asset and inspect its importer / rig setup
        string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("trump");
        foreach (var guid in guids)
        {
            string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
            result.Log("Found trump asset: {0}", path);
        }

        // Let's inspect Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed and Frank_Damage_2Handed_Hit children
        var go = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed");
        if (go != null)
        {
            result.Log("Object: {0}, pos: {1}, rot: {2}, scale: {3}", go.name, go.transform.position, go.transform.eulerAngles, go.transform.localScale);
            PrintChildren(go.transform, 0, result);
        }

        var goHit = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage_2Handed_Hit");
        if (goHit != null)
        {
            result.Log("Object: {0}, pos: {1}, rot: {2}, scale: {3}", goHit.name, goHit.transform.position, goHit.transform.eulerAngles, goHit.transform.localScale);
            PrintChildren(goHit.transform, 0, result);
        }
    }

    void PrintChildren(Transform t, int depth, ExecutionResult result)
    {
        if (depth > 4) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < t.childCount; i++)
        {
            var child = t.GetChild(i);
            var smr = child.GetComponent<SkinnedMeshRenderer>();
            var mf = child.GetComponent<MeshFilter>();
            result.Log("{0}- {1} (smr: {2}, mf: {3}, localPos: {4})", 
                new string(' ', depth * 2), 
                child.name, 
                smr != null ? smr.sharedMesh.name : "null", 
                mf != null ? mf.sharedMesh.name : "null",
                child.localPosition);
            PrintChildren(child, depth + 1, result);
        }
    }
}

using UnityEditor;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        var twoHanded = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed");
        var trumpInScene = twoHanded.transform.Find("trump");
        
        // Let's compare all bone local rotations and positions in trumpInScene against trump.fbx prefab
        var prefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Models/trump.fbx");
        
        var sceneBones = trumpInScene.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>();
        var prefabBones = prefab.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>();
        
        var prefMap = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, Transform>();
        foreach (var p in prefabBones) prefMap[p.name] = p;

        int modifiedCount = 0;
        foreach (var sb in sceneBones)
        {
            if (prefMap.TryGetValue(sb.name, out var pb))
            {
                if (Vector3.Distance(sb.localPosition, pb.localPosition) > 0.001f ||
                    Quaternion.Angle(sb.localRotation, pb.localRotation) > 0.1f ||
                    Vector3.Distance(sb.localScale, pb.localScale) > 0.001f)

                    modifiedCount++;
                    if (modifiedCount <= 15)

                        result.Log("Modified bone: {0}\n  scene: pos={1}, rot={2}\n  prefab: pos={3}, rot={4}",
                            sb.name, sb.localPosition, sb.localEulerAngles, pb.localPosition, pb.localEulerAngles);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        result.Log("Total modified bones in scene trump: {0} / {1}", modifiedCount, sceneBones.Length);
    }
}
"}, "agent": "CoreAgent"}</TOOL_CALL>

<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.RunCommand", "call_id": "df7f6265-f47a-4ecd-b341-620117adc5de", "args": {"title": "Analyze Twist Bone Skin Weights", "code": "using UnityEngine;
using UnityEditor;
using System.Collections.Generic;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        var prefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Models/trump.fbx");
        var smr = prefab.GetComponentInChildren<SkinnedMeshRenderer>();
        var mesh = smr.sharedMesh;
        
        var boneWeights = mesh.boneWeights;
        var bones = smr.bones;
        
        // Count how many vertices have weight on twist bones vs main bones
        var twistBoneIndices = new HashSet<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < bones.Length; i++)
        {
            if (bones[i].name.Contains("Twist") || bones[i].name.Contains("ShareBone"))
            {
                twistBoneIndices.Add(i);
            }
        }
        
        int vertsWithTwist = 0;
        float totalTwistWeight = 0f;
        foreach (var bw in boneWeights)
        {
            float tw = 0f;
            if (twistBoneIndices.Contains(bw.boneIndex0)) tw += bw.weight0;
            if (twistBoneIndices.Contains(bw.boneIndex1)) tw += bw.weight1;
            if (twistBoneIndices.Contains(bw.boneIndex2)) tw += bw.weight2;
            if (twistBoneIndices.Contains(bw.boneIndex3)) tw += bw.weight3;
            if (tw > 0.001f)
            {
                vertsWithTwist++;
                totalTwistWeight += tw;
            }
        }
        
        result.Log("Total vertices: {0}, verts with twist weight: {1} ({2:P1})", 
            mesh.vertexCount, vertsWithTwist, (float)vertsWithTwist / mesh.vertexCount);
        result.Log("Total twist bones count: {0}", twistBoneIndices.Count);
        foreach (int idx in twistBoneIndices)
        {
            result.Log("  Twist bone [{0}]: {1}", idx, bones[idx].name);
        }
    }
}
"}, "agent": "CoreAgent"}</TOOL_CALL>

<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.RunCommand", "call_id": "895b011f-bfe0-486b-972f-475ea9d2308a", "args": {"code": "using UnityEngine;
using UnityEditor;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        // 7 pairs in scene:
        // Pair 0: 2Handed
        // Pair 1: Assassin
        // Pair 2: Dual
        // Pair 3: GreatSword
        // Pair 4: Katana
        // Pair 5: Spear
        // Pair 6: Warrior

        var pairs = new (string attacker, string victim, float x)[] {
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed", "Frank_Damage_2Handed_Hit", -18f),
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Assassin", "Frank_Damage_Assassin_Hit", -12f),
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Dual", "Frank_Damage_Dual_Hit", -6f),
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_GreatSword", "Frank_Damage_GreatSword_Hit", 0f),
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Katana", "Frank_Damage_Katana_Hit", 6f),
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Spear", "Frank_Damage_Spear_Hit", 12f),
            ("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Warrior", "Frank_Damage_Warrior_Hit", 18f)
        };

        foreach (var p in pairs)
        {
            var atk = GameObject.Find(p.attacker);
            var vic = GameObject.Find(p.victim);

            if (atk != null)
            {
                result.RegisterObjectModification(atk.transform);
                atk.transform.position = new Vector3(p.x, 0f, -3.0f);
                atk.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 0f, 0f);
                
                var anim = atk.GetComponent<Animator>();
                if (anim != null)
                {
                    result.RegisterObjectModification(anim);
                    anim.applyRootMotion = true;
                    anim.cullingMode = AnimatorCullingMode.AlwaysAnimate;
                }
            }

            if (vic != null)
            {
                result.RegisterObjectModification(vic.transform);
                vic.transform.position = new Vector3(p.x, 0f, -1.2f);
                vic.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 180f, 0f);

                var anim = vic.GetComponent<Animator>();
                if (anim != null)
                {
                    result.RegisterObjectModification(anim);
                    anim.applyRootMotion = true;
                    anim.cullingMode = AnimatorCullingMode.AlwaysAnimate;
                }
            }

            result.Log("Positioned pair '{0}' & '{1}' at X={2}", p.attacker, p.victim, p.x);
        }

        // Adjust Main Camera to frame all pairs nicely
        var cam = GameObject.Find("Main Camera");
        if (cam != null)
        {
            result.RegisterObjectModification(cam.transform);
            var cameraComp = cam.GetComponent<Camera>();
            if (cameraComp != null)
            {
                result.RegisterObjectModification(cameraComp);
                cameraComp.fieldOfView = 60f;
            }
            cam.transform.position = new Vector3(0f, 3.5f, -9.5f);
            cam.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(14f, 0f, 0f);
            result.Log("Adjusted Main Camera to frame all characters!");
        }
    }
}

using UnityEditor;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        // 1. Check Spear attacker weapon hierarchy & SMR
        var spear = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Spear");
        if (spear != null)
        {
            var ws = spear.transform.Find("Weapon_Spear");
            var smr = ws?.GetComponent<SkinnedMeshRenderer>();
            result.Log("Spear GO: Weapon_Spear found={0}, SMR={1}, rootBone={2}, bonesCount={3}",
                ws != null, smr != null, smr?.rootBone?.name, smr?.bones?.Length);
            if (smr != null && smr.bones != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < smr.bones.Length; i++)
                {
                    var b = smr.bones[i];
                    result.Log("  spear bone[{0}]: {1}, parent={2}, pos={3}", i, b?.name, b?.parent?.name, b?.position);
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Check Warrior shield & sword
        var warrior = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Warrior");
        if (warrior != null)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < warrior.transform.childCount; i++)
            {
                var c = warrior.transform.GetChild(i);
                var smr = c.GetComponent<SkinnedMeshRenderer>();
                result.Log("Warrior child {0}: {1}, enabled={2}, rootBone={3}, mesh={4}",
                    i, c.name, smr != null ? smr.enabled.ToString() : "N/A", smr?.rootBone?.name, smr?.sharedMesh?.name);
            }
        }

        // 3. Check Critical_Dual animation clip root motion / curves
        var dual = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Dual");
        var dualAnim = dual?.GetComponent<Animator>();
        var dualClip = dualAnim?.runtimeAnimatorController?.animationClips[0];
        result.Log("Dual Clip: {0}, path={1}", dualClip?.name, AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(dualClip));

        // 4. Check Critical_2Handed animation clip root motion / curves
        var twoH = GameObject.Find("Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed");
        var twoHAnim = twoH?.GetComponent<Animator>();
        var twoHClip = twoHAnim?.runtimeAnimatorController?.animationClips[0];
        result.Log("2Handed Clip: {0}, path={1}", twoHClip?.name, AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(twoHClip));
    }
}
"}, "agent": "CoreAgent"}</TOOL_CALL>

{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        var fbxDual = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Meshes/Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Dual.FBX");
        var animDual = fbxDual.GetComponent<Animator>();
        var clipDual = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<AnimationClip>("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Meshes/Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Dual.FBX");
        if (clipDual == null)
        {
            foreach (var a in AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Meshes/Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_Dual.FBX"))

        result.Log("=== Dual Y positions on Frank (Original) ===");
        for (float t = 0f; t <= clipDual.length; t += 1.0f)
        {
            clipDual.SampleAnimation(fbxDual, t);
            var hips = animDual.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.Hips);
            var lFoot = animDual.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.LeftFoot);
            var rFoot = animDual.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.RightFoot);
            result.Log(string.Format("  t={0:F1}s: hips.y={1:F2}, lFoot.y={2:F2}, rFoot.y={3:F2}",
                t, hips.position.y, lFoot.position.y, rFoot.position.y));
        }

        // Also check what Frank_Damage_Dual_Hit does at t=2, 3, 4!
        var dualHitClip = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<AnimationClip>("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Animations/Damages_Critical_Set/hit_combo_weapon(3).anim");
        var trumpPrefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Models/trump.fbx");
        var victim = Object.Instantiate(trumpPrefab);
        var vAnim = victim.GetComponent<Animator>();
        result.Log("=== Dual Victim Y positions on Trump ===");
        for (float t = 0f; t <= dualHitClip.length; t += 1.0f)
        {
            dualHitClip.SampleAnimation(victim, t);
            var hips = vAnim.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.Hips);
            result.Log(string.Format("  t={0:F1}s: hips.y={1:F2}", t, hips.position.y));
        }
        Object.DestroyImmediate(victim);
    }
}
"}, "agent": "CoreAgent"}</TOOL_CALL>

using UnityEditor;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        var fbx2H = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Meshes/Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed.FBX");
        var animF = fbx2H.GetComponent<Animator>();
        var clip2H = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<AnimationClip>("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Meshes/Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed.FBX");
        if (clip2H == null)
        {
            foreach (var a in AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Meshes/Frank_Damage@Damage_Critical_2Handed.FBX"))
                if (a is AnimationClip c) { clip2H = c; break; }
        }

        var hit2HClip = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<AnimationClip>("Assets/Selected/Frank_Damages/Asset/Animations/Damages_Critical_Set/hit_combo_weapon(1).anim");

        var trumpPrefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Models/trump.fbx");
        var atk = Object.Instantiate(trumpPrefab);
        var vic = Object.Instantiate(trumpPrefab);
        var aAnim = atk.GetComponent<Animator>();
        var vAnim = vic.GetComponent<Animator>();

        atk.transform.position = new Vector3(-18f, 0f, -3.0f);
        atk.transform.rotation = Quaternion.identity;
        vic.transform.position = new Vector3(-18f, 0f, -1.2f);
        vic.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 180f, 0f);

        result.Log("=== 2Handed Atk vs Vic relative positions during animation ===");
        for (float t = 0f; t <= clip2H.length; t += 0.5f)
        {
            clip2H.SampleAnimation(atk, t);
            hit2HClip.SampleAnimation(vic, t);

            var aHips = aAnim.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.Hips);
            var aRHand = aAnim.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.RightHand);
            var vHips = vAnim.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.Hips);
            var vHead = vAnim.GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.Head);

            result.Log(string.Format("t={0:F1}s: Atk hand=({1:F2}, {2:F2}, {3:F2}) | Vic hips=({4:F2}, {5:F2}, {6:F2}) head=({7:F2}, {8:F2}, {9:F2})",
                t, aRHand.position.x, aRHand.position.y, aRHand.position.z,
                vHips.position.x, vHips.position.y, vHips.position.z,
                vHead.position.x, vHead.position.y, vHead.position.z));
        }

        Object.DestroyImmediate(atk);
        Object.DestroyImmediate(vic);
    }
}
